software.name: Bezel Custom Manager
software.description_en: Software used to customize default mask settings for modified systems.
software.description_zh: 魔改系统用来定制默认的遮罩设置的软件。
software.author: cbepx-me
software.instruction_zh: 遮罩配置文件放置位置在 卡1 的 anbernic/bezels 中对应模拟器名称的文件夹内, 扩展名为 .cfg。
software.instruction_en: The bezel config file is placed in the folder corresponding to the emulation name in anbernic/bezels of SD1, with the extension .cfg.

software.name: Clock
software.description_en: A software that supports clock, stopwatch, countdown, and time setting functions.
software.description_zh: 一款支持时钟，秒表，倒计时和时间设置功能的软件。
software.author: cbepx-me

software.name: Image Browser
software.description_en: A software for browsing images, supporting slideshow playback.
software.description_zh: 一款用来浏览图片的软件，支持幻灯片播放。
software.author: cbepx-me

software.name: Network Radio
software.description_en: A lightweight, full‑screen network radio player designed
software.description_zh: 一款轻量级全屏网络电台播放器软件
software.author: cbepx-me
software.instruction_zh: 添加广播播放列表 .txt 文件到 Radio 文件夹 (例如/mnt/mmc/Radio)。
software.instruction_en: Add the broadcast playlist. txt file to the Radio folder (e.g./mnt/mmc/Radio).

software.name: TV Live
software.description_en: TVLive is a live TV player designed for Anbernic handheld consoles
software.description_zh: TVLive 是一款轻量级直播电视播放器
software.author: cbepx-me
software.instruction_zh: 放置你的.m3u文件到TV文件夹,享受在设备上观看IPTV的乐趣。
software.instruction_en: Place your. m3u file in the TV folder and enjoy watching IPTV on your device.

software.name: Vertical Arcade bezels
software.description_en: One on one dedicated bezels resources for vertical arcade games
software.description_zh: 竖版街机游戏一对一专用边框资源文件
software.author: cbepx-me

software.name: RixelHK
software.description_en: RixelHK is an application designed to help users quickly download and install various games. It offers a wide range of game resources with one-click download and automatic installation features, streamlining the game download process. Users can browse by game category for a more seamless and personalized gaming experience.
software.description_zh: RixelHK 是一款帮助用户快速下载、安装各类游戏的应用程序。它提供丰富的游戏资源支持一键下载和自动安装，简化了游戏下载过程。用户可以按游戏类型进行分类查找，为用户提供更流畅和个性化的游戏体验。
software.author: RixelHK

software.name: ROCreader
software.description_en: A comic reader suitable for Anbernic RGds devices.
software.description_zh: 一款漫画阅读器，适用于 Anbernic RGds 设备。
software.author: Blood_roc

software.name: ROCreader
software.description_en: A comic reader suitable for Anbernic RGdsplus devices.
software.description_zh: 一款漫画阅读器，适用于 Anbernic RGdsplus 设备。
software.author: Blood_roc
